title: A prickly defense
hook: A defense can work at the moment of contact.

knows: Animals have body structures and life histories.
doesNotKnow: Identify contact as the transfer mechanism for porcupine quills.

misconception: A familiar animal feature always has the first explanation that comes to mind.
objective: Identify contact as the transfer mechanism for porcupine quills.

claims.text: How do porcupine quills typically reach an approaching predator? The diagram shows quills on the porcupine and an approaching animal making contact. Porcupines do not shoot their quills like darts. Detached quills can become embedded during contact, so distance alone does not cause the transfer.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: Smithsonian National Zoo, North American porcupine, https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/north-american-porcupine

claims.text: The diagram and its labels are schematic, not to scale and not an observation. Porcupine and visitor · schematic
A dog touches a porcupine and receives quills. Which mechanism is consistent with that encounter? Porcupines do not shoot quills; quills can become embedded on contact.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: Smithsonian National Zoo, North American porcupine, https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/north-american-porcupine
